commit.message:
Show scalar market chart values in the market's unit

The chart legend and tooltip appended % to every value, so a scalar
market such as the Ethereum basefee one showed "Market Estimate 9.1%"
while the header showed "9.092 gwei". Scalar values now use the unit
from the market name and the same formatting as the header estimate.
